scope: Public agent projects, frameworks, infrastructure and protocols relevant to finance, trading, shopping and arbitrage. Entries are research opportunities; they are not enrolled agents or partners.

targets.name: Alpaca MCP

targets.next_action: Offer the free MCP configuration for one bounded research workflow; retain operator choice over contributions.
